Kuro.tv 1.5 beta — take 11

Installs straight over the previous beta. Same version (1.5-beta, code 92),
same signing key, so no uninstall is needed.

APK      https://drive.google.com/file/d/1dlqrVG5cPKDzezq7eT78uy35J0d0oNkG/view

What is new in take 11
  1. Continue watching on Home. One rail under the header with the episodes you
     have actually started, newest first: poster, episode badge, accent progress
     line and how many minutes you are in. Tap to resume. It replaces the old
     "Recently watched" rail instead of listing the same shows twice, and it
     disappears completely when there is nothing in progress.
  2. Long press a poster. Hold for about half a second anywhere a poster appears
     — Home, My Lists, search, or a title page rail — and a compact sheet opens
     with Open, Add to / Remove from My List, and Hide this title. It does not
     fight horizontal scrolling, and a long press never also opens the title
     behind the sheet.
  3. What's new after an update. The first time you open this build you get one
     card at the top of Home with the changes, and a "Got it" button. It shows
     once per build. The same notes stay reachable in Settings > Developer >
     What's new.
  4. Downloads upkeep. Settings > Manage downloads now opens a real summary:
     how many episodes, how much space, then Delete watched episodes, Keep only
     the latest episode of each series, Delete all downloads, and an auto-clean
     switch (off / 7 days / 30 days) that quietly sweeps finished and watched
     downloads at start-up. The episode you are playing right now is never
     touched.

Fixed in this take
  - nothing regressed from take 10; themes, motion and the header updater are
    unchanged.

Known limitation (unchanged)
  - The in-app update check still reads the public release page, which points at
    1.4, so a 1.5 beta reports "already up to date". Beta builds are handed out
    here by hand until the beta update channel is built.

Previous take 10 files are trashed.
